resources.string:
When you open a video in the browser (Chrome, Samsung, Firefox, Edge and more), a small bubble appears at the edge of the screen. Tap it and the video goes to Studio for translation — without downloading it to the phone.

What is read: the browser's address bar, and the type of elements on the page (to find a video player) — not the text on the page. Nothing is stored and nothing is sent — until you tap the bubble, and then only the link is sent.

To pause it: the "Download bubble" tile in Quick Settings.
